verdict.rationale: Jira can be driven without its UI through its own documented, versioned Jira Cloud REST API, which has a published OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec, a Postman collection and a deprecation policy. Community users confirm scripting against it and running REST queries. However, there is no evidence of an official CLI, CI integrations or headless/CI-specific guidance, so automation means building against raw HTTP. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI pipeline integrations (e.g., CI actions/tokens guidance), hands-on evidence of Jira automation running in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
